h: Films, shows and the seaside on your doorstep
p: Cleethorpes is a town made for mixing things up, and Parkway sits right where you can do just that. Meridian Point takes its name from the Greenwich Meridian, which passes through Cleethorpes, so there's a nice bit of geography to point out to the kids on the way in. Nine screens mean there's nearly always something suitable, whether it's a big family release, a horror for the teenagers or something quieter for a couple's night out.

The live stage is a real bonus. Alongside films, the venue hosts shows and performances, so it's worth keeping an eye on the programme for something a bit different, especially around the festive season when a night out with the family is high on everyone's list.

The boating lake is just over the way, a lovely stretch of water for a walk round or a go on the pedal boats in season, and the Cleethorpes Coast Light Railway runs along the seafront with its little trains, which children absolutely love. The promenade heads north towards the centre of town, past the beach and up to the pier, with all the classic seaside fun along the way.

Further along the front, you'll find the cafés, chippies, ice cream kiosks and amusements that Cleethorpes is known for. The beach is huge and sandy at low tide, but the tide comes in quickly across the flats, so keep an eye on it and stay close to the shore with little ones.
At the southern end, past the boating lake, the coast opens up towards the Fitties chalets and Humberston, with dunes and saltmarsh that feel a world away from the busy central prom.

On sunny summer weekends and bank holidays, Kings Road and the seafront get busy, so allow extra time to park. The cinema's own car park is a real help, especially for anyone using the disabled bays near the doors. If you're coming by train, Cleethorpes station sits at the other end of the seafront, so it's a pleasant stroll along the prom to reach the cinema. A rainy-day film, followed by fish and chips on the front once the sky clears, is about as Cleethorpes as a day can get. For neighbouring Grimsby, the Fishing Heritage Centre is a short drive and makes a great add-on for anyone curious about the area's trawling past.
